## If a number looks wrong

This is the most important kind of report. Please include:

- the provenance record (the Solver record tab of the inspector, or
  `result.provenance.summary()`)
- the value you expected and its source
- the tolerance you would consider acceptable

A wrong number with a citation is a validation case waiting to be written.
